metadata.description: Project-agnostic spec-to-PR workflow plugins by Nhan Le.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Spec-to-PR workflow for any project: /devflow:init, /devflow:spec, /devflow:next-task, /devflow:sync, a merge gate Action for low-risk PRs, and a guard hook that blocks merges by Claude and pushes to protected branches.
